scopeAndLimitations: Verified means explicit biographical field retrieved from primary publisher for the exact register ID; it is not independent civil-registration/DOB certification.
Birth years are parsed from explicit athlete.displayDOB, never from profile titles or current age.
Country means published national playing-team association; it does not infer citizenship or erase historical dual representation.
Roles are all-format published taxonomy; T20 role changes require separate time/format evidence.
Bowling style metadata does not certify usage, strength, phase skills or precise abilities.
Public endpoint may return transient errors; failed/missing fields remain explicitly unresolved.
